troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting Guide
troubleshooting.subtitle: Common reasons your name might not appear:

items.title: Family members present but I'm not
items.desc: Your application might have been rejected or you were accidentally skipped.

items.title: Name removed recently
items.desc: Names get deleted during revision if BLO finds you absent. You need to re-register (Form 6).

items.title: Application pending
items.desc: If you applied recently, it might still be in process. Track your status.

items.title: Duplicate entries
items.desc: Multiple entries might cause suspension. Contact your BLO.

items.title: Data mismatch
items.desc: Your name spelling might be vastly different in records. Try partial search.

items.title: Personal Details
